title: Italian Almond Cake
description: A moist Italian almond cake recipe with a light and nutty flavor, perfect for a dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C) and grease a 9-inch (23cm) round cake pan.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to beat the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then beat in the vanilla and almond extracts.
With the mixer on low speed, gradually add the flour mixture and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Once the cake is completely cool, dust it with confectioners' sugar.
